title: Kewn DSH plugins / Kewn 的 DSH 插件
description: Curated DSH plugins (Apache-2.0). 自用 DSH 插件索引（Apache-2.0）。

plugins.name: dsh-peer-chat
plugins.title: Cross-instance chat / 跨实例会话对话
plugins.description: Local session tools, preset spawn/steer, and cross-instance messaging (peer_ask / peer_send / peer_steer / peer_chain / peer_tail). Peers are addressed by port; the web token is discovered from peer logs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 三合一：本地会话工具、按预设建会话/运行中插话、跨 DSH 实例对话；对端用端口标识，token 自动从对端日志识别。
plugins.author: Kewnn
